Container.Name: rewindarr
Container.Overview: Plex and Jellyfin statistics and habits, Spotify Wrapped style: a yearly Rewind for each user, a dashboard with top titles and users, and live activity. Statistics come from Tautulli (Plex only) or Tracearr, requests from Seerr. Everything else is set up from the web UI after logging in with Plex or Jellyfin.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings saved from the web UI. On start the container gives it to PUID:PGID.

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL
Config.Description: Address you open the app at, for example http://192.168.1.10:8383 or https://rewind.example.com.

Config.Name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Encrypts the login token. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the config folder and runs the app. 99 is nobody on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the config folder and runs the app. 100 is users on Unraid.
